providers.reason: Defense sector momentum is surging, with Hensoldt recording a 2.86% gain on October 26th. The company benefits from a record €10 billion order backlog and a high 2.4x book-to-bill ratio. Recent analyst upgrades and technical signals, including a cross above short-term moving averages, suggest strong near-term bullish continuation ahead of its November 5th statement.
providers.risk: Slowing revenue growth in H2 due to lower pass-through revenue components.

providers.reason: Hensoldt has clearly outperformed defense peers (+~14% YTD versus Rheinmetall's ~-35%) and only pulled back ~5% from its October high near €88. Deutsche Bank reiterated Buy with a €105 target and Jefferies added it to mid-cap top picks on valuation and spares-driven growth.
providers.risk: The stock has already rallied ~20% since mid-October, so profit-taking ahead of Q3 numbers on Nov 5 and the Nov 10 capital markets day could dominate; Q3 consensus EPS is negative.

providers.reason: Pre-earnings positioning ahead of Q3 results (Nov 5) with strong setup: H1 order intake doubled to €2.8B, Q2 EPS beat by 352%. Defense sector momentum and 6% upside to analyst target (€92) provide defined risk/reward.
providers.risk: Earnings miss or cautious guidance could reverse pre-earnings gains; defense sector sentiment remains volatile.

providers.reason: Jefferies upgraded to Buy Oct 5 with €98 target and consensus is Buy. Ukraine radar MoU adds order optionality; holding above €84.02 Xetra close.
providers.risk: Sector-wide defence pullback seen Oct 22 could persist with no numbers until Nov 5 results to support shares.
